summary: A Quote subscription on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX, Firstock NSE:26000): the V2 index tick has prices and the trade time only, and becomes an index Quote frame with the change from the previous close.

notes: NSE_INDEX subscribes on Firstock's NSE segment on both (firstock_mapping.py:16; brokers/families/noren/mapping.rs noren_exchange).
The change is worked by hand: round2(24450.3 - 24380.0) = 70.3 and round2(70.3 / 24380.0 * 100) = 0.29.

deviations.reason: Firstock's i_last_trade_time is in epoch seconds and the web sends it unchanged as ltt; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in ms.

The web's Firstock adapter sends no change for any instrument; an index's change keys follow the adapter (lead decision 2026-11-09), so they go once the per-broker index_change switch lands (lane wire).

An index frame carries no trade quantity or book totals (the recorded Zerodha index transcript); the web's Firstock Quote sends volume 0 for an index tick that carries none, and a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md).
